## Overview

Not being able to log in is no fun. However, if your school organization is using Clever passwords, Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google Workspace as a login method, you may be able to reset your password and the passwords of your students (students may also have the ability to reset their passwords). This depends on whether your school district has enabled this feature, and which login methods they have enabled for it.   
 

* * *

## Resetting teacher passwords

Not all school organizations allow teachers to reset their passwords.
